summary.zh: 圆腹、三足、双立耳，腹饰兽面纹，为礼制重器。
summary.en: A round-bellied tripod ding with two loop handles; a ritual vessel of the highest order.

body.zh: 器底铸铭文四字，记王室赏赐之事。
body.en: Four characters cast into the base record a royal grant.

body.zh: 腹部主纹为兽面纹，以云雷纹为地。
body.en: The body carries a taotie mask over a cloud-and-thunder ground.
